subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord guild channel configuration add an explicit name/slug pattern surface evaluated after exact and thread-parent entries but before literal `*`?
rationale: Pattern matching changes which Discord messages may reach agents, while interpreting existing record keys as globs would also change compatibility semantics.

options.title: Explicit Discord patterns
options.body: Add a separate pattern map or typed pattern entries with deterministic ordering, denial behavior, documentation, and authorization tests.

options.title: Implicit glob keys
options.body: Interpret wildcard characters in existing channel keys as patterns and accept the compatibility and ambiguity cost.

options.title: Keep exact-only
options.body: Retain exact entries and literal `*`, using category inheritance or reload improvements for adjacent needs.

recommendation.title: Explicit Discord patterns
recommendation.body: Add a separate pattern map or typed pattern entries with deterministic ordering, denial behavior, documentation, and authorization tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest verified history spans both the shared matching contract and Discord ingress authorization.
